# Station city illustrations

35 individually generated illustrations, one for each current Coastal Connections station. Created with the built-in image-generation tool; the final prompt for each image is in `prompts.json`. The runtime city/landmark mapping lives in `src/coastal-station-art.js`.

Final assets are JPEGs up to 1050 × 700 pixels. They appear in station upgrade panels with the landmark name and city. These are stylised illustrations: surrounding buildings, viewpoints and distances are artistic interpretations, rather than photographs or accurate street maps. Cardiff's initial draft was replaced with a more recognisable polygonal Norman keep on a grassy mound.

Primary references checked for less familiar station subjects:

- [Bangor Garth Pier — Visit Wales](https://www.visitwales.com/destinations/north-wales/things-do-bangor).
- [St Cybi’s Church, Holyhead — parish history](https://www.holyheadparishchurches.co.uk/st-cybis-church-holyhead/history-st-cybis-church/introduction/).
- [National Waterfront Museum, Swansea — Museum Wales](https://museum.wales/swansea/the-sea-and-us/).
- [Coquelles and Folkestone terminals — LeShuttle](https://www.leshuttle.com/fr-fr/nos-terminaux).

All 35 final image files have been decoded and checked in their corresponding game panels, including desktop and mobile layouts. Original generated PNGs remain in the local image-generation output folder; discarded drafts are not runtime assets.
